stories.title: Micron details ambitious DRAM and NAND roadmap — 3D NAND, High-NA EUV, new materials, and custom silicon makes a comeback
stories.summary: As DRAM and 3D NAND are about to adopt all-new technologies, custom types of memory are about to become mainstream as AI developers face limitations with current solutions.

stories.title: AI data centers comprehensively defeated at US midterm elections
stories.summary: Several counties put data center issues on the ballot during the midterm elections, with most Americans voting against data center development in their county.

stories.title: Binance heist began with fake job interviews and a malicious Homebrew download
stories.summary: Binance has revealed how Norh Korean attackers spent months compromising systems and employees with malicious developer software and a fake recruitment process. The intrusions eventually gave hackers access to the exchange’s internal wallet signing systems, enabling the October 29 theft.

stories.title: PHP vulnerability post-mortem reveals bug was known two years ago
stories.summary: PHP has a harvest season to remember — AI-automated bug hunting reaps what years of technical debt have sown.

stories.title: Nvidia can only fulfill 1% of China’s massive $70 billion GPU order for AI chips, report claims
stories.summary: Just 1% of chips promised to major Chinese companies to power their AI ambitions will be delivered, according to reports.

stories.title: Open source project renders your Windows 11 desktop using the NPU rather than the GPU
